evidence.title: Gallery - Templates, Examples and Articles written in LaTeX - Overleaf, Online LaTeX Editor

name: LaTeX templates and examples — CVs and résumés
summary: Gallery of LaTeX CV and résumé templates on Overleaf, with staff picks, recent uploads and community examples.
description: Overleaf's gallery filtered to CVs and résumés: LaTeX templates, examples and community articles that open in the online LaTeX editor, each with a description and author. Items are split into staff-picked and recent lists and cross-linked with related tags such as cover letter, two-column, XeLaTeX and LuaLaTeX.
